title: After a few weeks of hacking, I finally got the MCP host set up inside Unity!
author: Josvdw
selftext: Getting the DLL to play nice was the hard part! This means you can use any other tool from within Unity. Here’s a quick example using the Blender MCP from within Unity to create a Sakura tree scene.

comments.author: Benhamish-WH-Allen
comments.body: It looks neat, a few more years and it will be awesome.

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: Wow! That's amazing. What LLM does it use? Is there a tutorial on how to install all this?

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body: Sorry for the late reply! You can use any of the popular LLMs. Instructions for installation in our Discord: [https://discord.gg/y4p8KfzrN4](https://discord.gg/y4p8KfzrN4)

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body: It's using Blender from within Unity using Coplay
